About Us

Thornfield Haulage was built by players, for players. We started with a simple idea — create a VTC that feels like a real family, not just another number.

We run organised convoys, share custom liveries, and support each other on every mile. Whether you drive casually a few times a week or live on the open road, you're welcome here.

No pressure. Just good hauls and great company.
